g.text: A: n = human 1,071,725, mouse 534,246, rat 162,097, all 1,768,068 sites; set-B tiers, study-cluster rule; BRONZE is hatched. B: the PubMed-ID count rule and the
study-cluster rule differ in thresholds, so the change cannot be attributed to the counting method alone; set A tiers come from the human file with two source flags
(agreement score 0 to 2); set B adds the dbPTM flag (0 to 3); BRONZE is hatched. C: same sources; n is the number of sites with a score of 2 or more. D: records with at
least one non-primary PMID, records linked to the PhosphoSitePlus database paper, and GOLD records that fall to SILVER when the non-primary PMIDs are not counted.
E: set-B tiers, study-cluster rule; left box primary tiers, right box tiers with the non-primary PMIDs not counted (sites with a year: GOLD 342,437 and 332,880, SILVER
750,801 and 742,923, BRONZE 674,782 and 663,781); boxes span the interquartile range, whiskers the 5th to 95th percentile, printed values are medians; the axis begins
